upstream.description: CloudGallery is an Android app that lets you instantly back up all your images to Telegram using Bot API — simple, Secure, and infinite.

classification.analysis: Chitralaya CloudGallery is an open-source Android app (Kotlin, Jetpack Compose) that backs up phone photos to a user's own Telegram account via the Telegram Bot API, functioning as a free, privacy-first alternative to Google Photos or iCloud. Bot tokens and chat IDs are stored in the Android keystore, and a local (and Telegram-backed) JSON metadata database tracks synced images for browsing and cross-device restore. It targets individual privacy-conscious users wanting unlimited photo backup without a company-run cloud, and is a solo-developer, community-supported project that intentionally lacks advanced features like sharing links, multi-user support, or end-to-end encryption.

use_cases.title: Back up phone photos privately using your own Telegram bot
Avoid Google Photos or iCloud by self-managing cloud storage
Reference a Jetpack Compose Android app with local database sync
